dogecoin.text:
#Dogecoin is making large moves these days.
The altcoin has become one of the biggest memes in the crypto world.
#ElonMusk is a big fan of memes and Doge.

And #crypto shows a strong rebound after a healthy correction.
#Ethereum is moving towards new all-time highs, showing strength versus #bitcoin.
Even #Dogecoin is still up for the day after the ‘buy the rumour, sell the news’ event.

5/6
